bug_semantics: CWE-276 in the default web-console/Jolokia authorization: Jetty maps the Jolokia JMX-HTTP bridge at /api/jolokia/* onto the low-privilege user/users role (securityConstraint) rather than admin/admins, while assembly/src/release/conf/jolokia-access.xml allows all operations on org.apache.activemq:* MBeans. An authenticated non-admin web-console login can therefore POST exec requests (addQueue, removeQueue, and other BrokerView management ops) that the console's *.action mapping already reserved for admins. On 5.19.x the shipped jetty-realm.properties account user:user,user is sufficient; on 6.x any users-role login is, because pathSpec / is the catch-all users,admins constraint.
flaw_origin: AMQ-4567 split console roles and narrowed admin-only mapping to *.action, leaving /api unconstrained. AMQ-4979 (e366917efc28a4da29e8b4220220c1005972ed87) then added /api/* to securityConstraint (roles user,admin) instead of adminSecurityConstraint, first granting authenticated low-privilege accounts access to Jolokia. Jolokia itself was never role-aware and did not deny addQueue/removeQueue (implicit until AMQ-9201 explicitly allowed all org.apache.activemq:* operations). AMQ-5388 dropped /api/*; AMQ-8522 restored it on the same user-role constraint (surviving 5.19.x pathSpec). 6.x later used pathSpec / as catch-all (AMQ-9476) still with users,admins roles.

reasoning: CVE-2026-49157 is a real CWE-276 default-permissions bug, not a withdrawn advisory (CVE.org PUBLISHED). Attack path: authenticate as a low-privilege web user -> HTTP to /api/jolokia/ (AgentServlet) -> Jolokia exec on org.apache.activemq:type=Broker addQueue/removeQueue. Two cooperating defaults make this work: (1) Jetty puts Jolokia on the user/users constraint that also gates ordinary console pages, unlike *.action which is admin-only; (2) jolokia-access.xml is not role-aware and allows all broker operations. The smallest first-write of (1) is AMQ-4979 e366917ef, which inserted /api/* into securityConstraintMapping; the parent tree lacks that pathSpec so Jolokia was not yet granted to authenticated user-role logins. Later AMQ-5388 deleted /api/* and AMQ-8522 re-added it on the same too-broad role (surviving 5.19.x blame); 6.x rewritten pathSpec / still applies users,admins as a catch-all. Those are reintroductions/refactors, not a new mechanism, so they are not the BIC. AMQ-9201 wrote the surviving explicit org.apache.activemq:* allow that names addQueue/removeQueue capability, but exec of those ops already existed by Jolokia default at AMQ-4979. Fix #2025/052369f00 (backported to 6.2.6 as be8415f24 and 5.19.7 as 66efdf121) both restricts /api/jolokia/* to admins and denylists addQueue/removeQueue, landing at/after the patched tags and absent from 5.19.6/6.2.5.
